artboards.title: A stay — the pane becomes a page

annotations.text:
THE PROPOSAL — three changes to the frame, none to the screens.

1. A day spine that is true everywhere, not only on Today.
2. A left rail instead of the growing icon dock, with live state beside each area.
3. ONE record pane serving every list — it replaces both the Today master-detail and the Inbox three-pane.
Same pane, different record. Today opens a booking in it; the Inbox opens an enquiry in it. Today those are two separate desktop layouts doing one job.

What is UNCHANGED: pulse line → exceptions → verdict fold groups, the status capsules, serif for money, the cottage colours. That anatomy is already on every screen — this proposal is the frame around it, which is why it is cheap to build.
Cottages leaves the Settings index and becomes its own area — it is the thing you edit most and it was buried under twenty rows. Settings keeps the account and system half.

Two directions I did NOT take, sketched honestly so the choice is a real one. Each names what it would win and what it would cost. If either reads better than the proposal, say so and I will build that one out instead.

THE SAME DESIGN, IN A BROWSER — three real widths, not three tidy ones.

The left rail was the one decision I flagged, and this is what it costs. At 1440 it earns its place: every area named, with live state beside it.

At 1180 it folds to icons — and folded, it IS a vertical dock. The proposal has reinvented the thing it replaced, minus the counts, which degrade to pips because £1,190 does not fit in 62px.

So the honest read: the rail is a win on a big screen and a wash on a small one. If most of your back-office time is on a phone or a half-width window, that argues for keeping the header dock and taking only the day spine — which survives every width.

ON A PHONE, TWO OF THE THREE CHANGES DO NOT EXIST.

The RAIL has nowhere to go — it becomes the bottom dock, which is what the app already has. The PANE has nowhere to go either — the record opens as a page with a back link, which is also what the app already does below 1200.

What crosses over is the DAY SPINE, and it is the whole proposal on a phone. It costs about 150px at rest, so it condenses to one line the moment you leave Today: the day sentence and a count of what still wants you, carried on every screen. That is the change I would actually defend.

The third duty does not fit at 390px — it becomes "1 more" rather than wrapping to a third row of chips.
